test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Finance Minister, in the Union Budget 2024-25, announced the increased loan limit to Rs. 20 lakhs from the existing Rs. 10 lakhs of which of the following schemes?

options.text: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)** was launched in **April 2015** by the **Government of India**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide loans up to **Rs. 10 lakhs** to **non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises**.
 
• The loans are categorized into three products based on the loan amount: **Shishu** (up to Rs. 50,000), **Kishore** (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakhs), and **Tarun** (Rs. 5 lakhs to Rs. 10 lakhs).
 
• The objective of the scheme is to promote **entrepreneurship** and generate **employment** opportunities.
 
• Under the Union Budget 2024-25, the loan limit under PMMY has been increased to **Rs. 20 lakhs**.
 
• The scheme is implemented through **Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, and NBFCs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)**__

 __
 
• The **CGTMSE** scheme was launched by the **Government of India** and the **SIDBI** to provide credit guarantees for loans extended to **Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **collateral-free credit** to the MSE sector.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)**__
 __
 
• The **PMEGP** is a credit-linked subsidy program launched in **2008** to generate employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in **rural and urban areas**.
 
• It is implemented by the **Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)**.
 
 
 
• **Stand-Up India Scheme**__
 
 
• The **Stand-Up India Scheme** was launched in **April 2016** to promote entrepreneurship among **Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes and women**.
 
• It provides bank loans between **Rs. 10 lakhs and Rs. 1 crore** for setting up greenfield enterprises.
